sourceTitle: Foster care pay and allowances (Lincolnshire Fostering Service, Lincolnshire County Council)
extras: Extra allowances for the child's birthday, religious festivals and holidays (the page does not give the amounts)
Retention bonuses for carers who stay with the service: £500 after one year, £1,000 after five years and £2,000 after ten years
Higher weekly payments for carers approved for the council's FOCUS fostering schemes
summary: Lincolnshire publishes a weekly fostering allowance for each child, set by the child's age and effective from 1 April 2026. The page does not list a separate fee or skills payment for mainstream carers, so ask the fostering team how any additional payments work before you apply.
